svg.aria-label: Development telemetry from the GitHub API, refreshed daily: 845 contributions in the last 12 months on 40 active days, longest streak 15 days, 17 public repositories. Shown as a night sky: each star is a day of commits, grouped into one constellation per public repository, with 594 contributions in private repositories and other activity as an unnamed cluster. Moon: waning gibbous, 84% lit. Last sync 2026-11-28.
